name: Driving Instructors
tagline: Learner lessons, test prep, refresher, logbook
extra_prompt: You are booking for a driving instructor. Ask about the student's experience, licence type (auto/manual), test date, and preferred pickup location. Ask about any anxiety or special needs. Quote prices only from the reference answers, and say the final price is confirmed on the day. Do not promise a pass on a driving test or any guarantee not in the reference answers.

kb.a: {price_note} Lessons are priced per hour, with lower rates for lesson packages. Ask us which package suits your learning plan.

kb.q: Do you do manual or automatic?
kb.a: We teach both manual and automatic. Tell us which licence you are working towards.

kb.q: Do you provide a car for the test?
kb.a: Yes, test car hire is available for students who have lessons with us. Ask us about the test car hire rate when you book.
Yes, we do logbook lessons and sign off the required hours in your logbook. Bring your logbook to every lesson.

kb.q: Can you help with a test booking?
kb.a: We can help you prepare for the test and coordinate the test car and time. The official test booking is made with [your state road authority].
Yes, we run mock tests in the test area. Mock tests are priced per test, so book one when you feel ready.

kb.q: Do you teach overseas licence holders?
kb.a: Yes, we help with overseas licence conversion. Bring your overseas licence and tell us the country of issue so we can check the steps.
Yes, we work with nervous and mature-age learners. Tell us about your anxiety so we can plan lessons at a pace that suits you.
Yes, for licensed drivers returning to driving. Tell us how long it has been since you last drove so we can plan the refresher.
Yes, we do senior refresher and assessment lessons. Tell us about any health or mobility needs so we can tailor the lesson.
We pick up within the local metro area. Ask us to confirm your suburb before you book.
Lessons are usually 1 hour, with 1.5 hour options. Tell us your preferred length when you book.
Our instructors hold [accreditation number and state authority]. Ask us for proof before your first lesson.
Cancelling with less than {cancellation_notice} may incur a fee. Let us know early so we can offer the time to another learner.
{discount_note} Ask us for the package price when you plan your block of lessons.

kb.q: What should I bring to my first lesson?
kb.a: Bring your learner permit or licence, your logbook if you have one, and any glasses or medical notes you need to drive.

compliance.guidance: Driving instructors need accreditation from the state road authority. Check the rules for your state before you take bookings.
